script:
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\audit2"
"=== pull latest code (dashboard + live status) ==="
git pull -q origin main 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3
git log --oneline -1
"=== dashboard ==="
$tsip = (tailscale ip -4 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1)
if ($tsip) { $tsip = $tsip.Trim() } else { $tsip = "0.0.0.0" }
"binding to: $tsip"
try {
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://${tsip}:8472/api/status" -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
  "dashboard already running"
} catch {
  Start-Process -FilePath ".\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -ArgumentList "status_server.py --config tests/test_config.yaml --host $tsip --port 8472" -WindowStyle Hidden
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
  try {
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://${tsip}:8472/api/status" -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null
    "dashboard started OK on ${tsip}:8472"
  } catch {
    "DASHBOARD START FAILED: " + $_.Exception.Message
  }
}
"=== videos ==="
Get-ChildItem testdata/videos | Select-Object Name, @{N="MB";E={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,1)}}
& .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
"=== pipeline (live status enabled) ==="
python main.py --config tests/test_config.yaml --workers 4 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8
"=== vid49 results ==="
python -c "
import csv
rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open('testdata/audit_out/report.csv')) if 'vid49' in r['video']]
print('flagged frames for vid49.mp4:', len(rows))
seen = set()
for r in rows[:30]:
    seen.add(r['tracks_failed'])
    print('frame', r['frame'], 't=' + r['timestamp_s'] + 's', 'failed_tracks=' + r['tracks_failed'], 'faces_failed=' + r['faces_failed'])
print('distinct track sets:', len(seen))
"
"=== review queue ==="
python -c "
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect('testdata/audit_out/review.sqlite')
print('total review items:', con.execute('select count(*) from review_items').fetchone()[0])
"
